title: Intake extraction (LLM output). Candidates only: nothing here changes a plan until the user confirms.

templateId.description: Must be one of the ids given in the prompt

evidence.description: Verbatim span of the (masked) user text

key.description: A fact catalogue key given in the prompt; identifying keys are never offered

value.description: An option value of that key, or __unknown__

evidence.description: Verbatim span of the masked user text that states it

unmatched.description: Statements that matter but match no option; kept as notes, never coerced

identifyingDataSeen.description: True if the input still contained identifying data after masking; the app then discards the response and re-masks
